author: Priya S.
title: Quote to install in under two weeks
body: Booked the measure through the chat on a Sunday night, Josh came out Tuesday and the fence was up the following week. They even sorted the paperwork with our neighbour. Couldn't be easier.

author: Mark & Leanne T.
title: Frameless glass looks incredible
body: Passed the shire pool inspection first go. The glass is spotless and the gate closes softly every time. The South West crew were tidy and friendly.

author: Daniel K.
title: Estate approval sorted
body: They knew exactly what our estate guidelines allowed and the slat fence was approved without any back and forth. Quality is outstanding.

author: Helen W.
title: Gate works from my phone now
body: Replaced our old swing gate with a sliding one and a Centurion motor. Clear pricing, no surprises, and they showed me how to use the app before leaving.

author: Tom R.
title: Great work, slight delay
body: Rain pushed our install back two days but they kept us updated by SMS the whole time. The retaining and fence line up perfectly.

author: Aisha M.
title: Picket fence of my dreams
body: Bought a DIY PVC kit and then chickened out — they installed it for me the next week at a fair price. The front yard looks brand new.

author: Northline Logistics
title: Professional commercial team
body: 420m of Garrison fencing with two sliding gates, delivered on schedule with all SWMS and inductions handled. Will use again.

author: James P.
title: Local crew, local prices
body: Good to have a proper fencing company based in Bunbury. Turned up when they said they would and cleaned up everything.
